description:
See attached draft CSO. Request draft detailed CSO by 8 May, NLT 1300 MT. 

Please note after industry day the final CSO will be posted. If you requested the draft documents and were cleared to receive the detailed CSO, the detailed CSO will be sent directly the day of final posting. For those that don’t participate in the draft stage, you will only have 3 business days from the day of final posting to request the detailed CSO. Highly encourage those interested to participate in the draft stage.
